narr: During the afternoon and early evening of Saturday, August, 7th, a line of thunderstorms developed across west central Wisconsin. These storms remained nearly stationary for an hour or two and produced over 5 inches of rainfall in a short period of time across Eau Claire. There were social media pictures of standing water over several feet in a few neighborhoods. There were several homes that had water in their basement due to the flood waters. In addition, 1 to 2 feet of water was observed at the intersection of Eddy and Abbie Hill drive where a few cars stalled out.
ev: There was 1 to 2 feet of water at the intersection of Eddy Lane and Abbie Hill Drive. A few cars stalled out in this intersection. In addition, there were a few residential areas that had flooded basements due to the flood waters.
